## Our Washington Office

## Washington Office

Illinois Eye Center’s Washington location opened in 2013, and expanded in 2017 to better serve our community.

For more than 60 years, Illinois Eye Center has provided comprehensive eye care to thousands of families throughout Central Illinois. Our number one goal is patient satisfaction, and we strive to respond to patients’ unique needs as quickly as we can.

Here you’ll find our Washington office hours and directions. If there’s ever anything we can do to improve your experience at Illinois Eye Center, please don’t hesitate to contact us.

We provide diagnosis and treatment of a variety of conditions, including:

- Cataracts
- Corneal Diseases
- Diabetic Eye Disease
- Dry Eye Syndrome
- Floaters
- Glaucoma
- Inflammatory Eye Disease and Ocular Infections
- Routine Eye Care

Our eye care services include:

- Contact Lens Fittings
- Eyeglass Frames
- Lenses and Accessories
- optomap®

## Have an Emergency?

The doctors of Illinois Eye Center have their own patients, but also practice as a team. If you develop a problem after hours or during a time when your doctor is unavailable, you may see our on-call physician. One of our doctors is always on call, 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

If you require immediate attention, please call us at (309) 243-2400. After hours, our answering service will contact us on your behalf. Depending on the severity of your situation, you may need to go to the Emergency Department at the hospital. The emergency department physician will examine you and then contact us.
